newsitem.title: USA: Samsung to buy rest of AST Research.
newsitem.headline: Samsung to buy rest of AST Research.

text.p: Samsung Electronics Co. Ltd. will launch a tender offer to buy the remaining stake of AST Research Inc. it does not currently own, for $5.40 a share in cash, or about $170 million, the companies said Tuesday.

South Korea-based Samsung will acquire about 31 million shares of AST's common stock outstanding. Samsung and its affiliates currently own a stake of about 46 percent in AST and have options which, if exercised, would result in ownership of about 49 percent of the Irvine, Calif.-based computer maker.
The tender offer will begin on April 21 and expire on May 19.

"Samsung strongly believes in taking a long-term approach to the PC business and in increasing AST's global brand awareness and market share," said Kwang-Ho Kim, president, CEO and chairman of Samsung North America and chairman of AST's Board of Directors.
AST's board of directors unanimously approved the merger agreement and tender offer, the companies said.
AST's stock gained 43.75 cents to $5.1875 on Nasdaq.
